pages.text: The Energy Liquefier converts solid ingredients into liquid energy (energy value per ingredient):$(li)Nether Star → 1000 mb Nether Pure Energy: 50M$(li)Wither Rose → 400 mb Nether Compound Energy: 5M$(li)End Mixture + 1 solid → 500 mb End Mixture Fuel: 10M$(li)Dragon Mixture + 1 solid → 500 mb End Dragon Fuel: 50M$(li)the World Base Fuel ingredient (Golden Carrot + Sculk Block + Golden Apple + Akaishi Essence Block) + 1 solid → 100 mb World Base Fuel: 10M

$(bold)Preparation:$(reset) the last three recipes require a solid medium in addition to the main ingredient.$(br2)Nether Stars and Wither Roses are renewable; the End, Dragon and World Base ingredients come from the mixture routes covered in Secrets of Life.$(br2)The liquids are stored in a tank and then fed to the $(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l) or the $(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l).
This is the first step of the Liquid Fuel Chain; the overview is in $(l:akaishi:liquid_fuel)Liquid Fuel Chain$(/l), and downstream processing and blending are linked above.
